shortDescription: Calls the FICS Mortgage Servicer batch service API to create the late notices report and summary report PDFs at the desired locations

options.name: api_log_directory
options.description: this is the directory that the API logs will be created in

options.name: api_token
options.description: this is the api token used for authentication to the API

options.name: batch_service_api_url
options.description: This is the URL of the desired API

options.name: dest
options.description: This is the full path to where the late notices file will be created, it creates parent directories if they do not exist

options.name: summary_dest
options.description: This is the full path to where the late notices summary file will be created, it creates parent directories if they do not exist
